conventions.document_digest: sha256 hex of the original document's UTF-8
conventions.draw: NUL-join seed, document digest, purpose, key and "<bump>.<index>"; sha256 the UTF-8; first 8 bytes big-endian unsigned, mod n
conventions.offsets: render spans are [orig_start, orig_end, new_start, new_end, original] in code points, not UTF-16 code units
conventions.oracles: "production": stop_words = lexicon stop words, given_name = gazetteer common given name, notable = gazetteer notable; "none": invent's defaults (no stop words, no oracles)
conventions.ordered_maps: restore_map, placeholder_restore_map, adlib_map, adlib_tokens and tokens are [key, value] lists in insertion order, which restore's first-wins rule reads
conventions.render: the reference arm's placeholder output over `original`, then render_adlib(result, original, seed) with no identity
conventions.seed: an integer seed is drawn as its decimal string
conventions.spec: README.md, section "Adlib", is the byte-level rule text
